exposure: Delivery mode (Caesarean section vs. vaginal delivery)
outcome: Predicted metabolic profiles of the gut microbiome
finding: Both Caesarean section and perinatal antibiotics markedly influenced the predicted metabolic profiles of the gut microbiome at the age of 1 year.
mod_finding: Caesarean section was found to significantly influence the functional profiles of the gut microbiome in children at the age of one year.
